source: game data of the installed BG3 (build in game_build), read-only from Shared.pak, Gustav.pak and GustavX.pak (modules Shared, SharedDev, Gustav, GustavDev, GustavX, a later module's same UUID or entry wins) by tools/dev/arena_static_gen.py
races_source: A1 races (orchestrator D411), read 2026-11-03 from the installed game's paks with tools/pak.py, read-only (no game run): Shared.pak Public/Shared/Races/Races.lsx (race and subrace ids, ParentGuid, ProgressionTableUUID); Public/Shared + Public/SharedDev Progressions/Progressions.lsx, the level-1 row of the parent race's table and of the subrace's (SharedDev's row wins over Shared's with the same UUID; Gustav, GustavDev, GustavX and the hotfix paks carry none of these rows); Public/Shared/Lists/SpellLists.lsx (the Drow cantrip list). `race` is the id a template of that race reads (Races.lsx UUID of the subrace, or the race when it has none); `rows` the level-1 rows in the order the kit applies them, parent first.
backgrounds_source: Shared.pak Public/Shared/Backgrounds/Backgrounds.lsx (uuid -> passive) and Public/Shared*/Stats/Generated/Data/Passive.txt (the passive's ProficiencyBonus boosts), read 2026-11-03 with tools/pak.py
hirelings_source: Each class's hireling (route H's reference, A1 D411), read 2026-11-03 with tools/pak.py: Shared.pak Public/SharedDev/Origins/Origins.lsx Hireling_<Class> (UUID, RaceUUID, SubRaceUUID, BackgroundUUID, GlobalTemplate, LockRace true); Gustav.pak Mods/GustavDev/Globals/SYS_Hirelings/Characters/_merged.lsf S_GLO_Hirelings_<Class> (MapKey = GlobalTemplate, TemplateName = the root); Shared.pak Public/SharedDev/RootTemplates/_merged.lsf Hirelings_Stats_Player_<Class> (its ParentTemplateId) and Public/Shared/RootTemplates/_merged.lsf the parent's Race (BASE_HalfElves_Female_Wood, BASE_Humans_Female -> BASE_Humans, BASE_Dwarves_Female_Hill, BASE_Elves_Male_Drow_Seldarine). Live-read: the Fighter's template race (live check 9, d9401d40 Race 76057327), and the Cleric's and Wizard's templates and races with Ext.Template.GetAllRootTemplates (S1, 2026-11-06: Race 4fda6bce, 2cf6c770); arena.mirror_spawn refuses a template of another race, so the others fail closed until read.
